model: lucidrains x-unet XUnet 2D (dim 32, mults [1, 2, 4, 8], attn at 1/8 + mid), 1-ch asinh adapter, full-res head, focal_dice loss

upstream.ref: XUnet class used unmodified; attention -> SDPA, 1-frame Conv3d -> conv2d at runtime

eval.eval_cmd: cd $PK/work/h6 && python -m seg.evaluate --model lucid_unet --config configs/lucid_unet.yaml --ckpt /sdf/data/lcls/ds/prj/prjcwang31/results/peaknet-seg-sprint/checkpoints/h6/xu_d/best.pt --split test --out /sdf/data/lcls/ds/prj/prjcwang31/results/peaknet-seg-sprint/evals/h6/xu_d/test_metrics.json --save-overlays /sdf/data/lcls/ds/prj/prjcwang31/results/peaknet-seg-sprint/figures/h6/xu_d --n-overlays 4 --workers 6 --tile 1024

notes: lucidrains x-unet XUnet used unmodified (5.9M params, dim 32, 4 stages, full-res output, which suits 1-2 px peaks); glue = asinh((x-median)/32)/3 input adapter, pad to /32, runtime swaps (einsum attention -> F.scaled_dot_product_attention; 1-frame Conv3d -> conv2d, same weights, ~1.7x faster). Trained from scratch with the shared seg/train.py: random 512 crops (80% centred on peaks), bs 6, AdamW lr 6e-4 cosine, focal(alpha .25) x10 + dice, 2938 steps / 55 min on one shared L40S (sdfada013 idx3); best ckpt + threshold 0.95 picked on 100 val images (val peak F1 0.889). Whole-test eval: tile 1024, no TTA, no saturated mask. Dead ends: focal_dice with w_main=1 collapsed to all-background (val F1 0.000 at step 1000, run xu_c); bs8 with full-res val used 35 GB on a shared GPU (xu_a, stopped). Main errors: false peaks on saturated 65535 pixel lines; round 2 (xu_ft) fine-tunes with saturated pixels zeroed in the adapter.
